decisions.decision: Title-Case lifecycle values are canonical and case-sensitive
decisions.acceptanceImpact: API, persistence, and UI use the same values

decisions.decision: GET never generates a report and returns 404 when absent
decisions.acceptanceImpact: No false report success or unstable identity

decisions.decision: Archive returns 202 Archiving and executes a resumable report-first job
decisions.compatibility: Clients poll tenant detail for Archived
decisions.acceptanceImpact: Terminal success follows evidence persistence and cleanup

decisions.decision: TTL is measured from last accepted simulation activity
decisions.compatibility: created_at remains the initial activity timestamp

decisions.decision: Signal, recommendation, and storage counters update at durable write reservation boundaries
decisions.acceptanceImpact: List/detail counters are tenant-scoped and budget-enforced
